content.title: About
content.content: Puerto Rican Seasoning with Ham (4514) is a flavorful spice blend typical of Puerto Rican cuisine, featuring dried ham, garlic, paprika, oregano, cumin, and aromatic herbs. It delivers a rich, slightly smoky and savory taste, perfect for meat, fish, vegetables, and rice dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend is based on traditional Puerto Rican recipes where ham provides the main umami source.
Paprika gives the seasoning its bright red color and a hint of sweetness.
Cumin and oregano add the characteristic Caribbean aroma.
It is commonly used in dishes like arroz con pollo and mofongo.
The dry mix lasts longer than fresh herbs and retains its flavor for years.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: The dried ham component supplies protein important for tissue repair.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Ham and spices provide a modest amount of iron, supporting normal blood formation.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Paprika and oregano contain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Cumin is known to aid digestive processes and reduce bloating.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: The seasoning contains no added sugar, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ham and added salt can increase sodium intake, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Spice allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be sensitive to paprika, oregano, or cumin.

items.title: Histamine levels
items.content: Dried ham can contain histamines that may trigger reactions in sensitive people.

items.title: Not suitable for vegetarians
items.content: The product contains meat, so vegetarians and vegans should look for plant‑based alternatives.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Sprinkle the seasoning on meat, fish, or poultry before grilling or baking, add it to marinades, soups, rice dishes, and vegetable stews. For a stronger flavor, lightly toast the blend in a dry pan before use.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the seasoning in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For extended shelf life, keep it in the refrigerator to preserve aroma. Keep moisture out to prevent clumping.
